name: Workflow Markdown Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for reading and writing Markdown nodes through typed backend actions only.

findGuidance.how: Find Markdown nodes by nodeId (exact) or title (substring) with markdown.find. It returns metadata only (nodeId, title, revision) — never content. Share nodes by nodeId only in request contextRefs; receivers read the content through typed actions.

revisionGuard.guidance: markdown.patch, markdown.append, and markdown.replace accept optional expectedRevision (and lockId). When expectedRevision does not match the current revision, no write occurs.

conflict.recover: Reread the node (markdown.read), merge your changes, re-acquire the lock if needed, and retry with the fresh currentRevision.

locked.recover: The lease expires at expiresAt (default 30 seconds). Wait for expiry or ask the holder to release, then retry.

controlSurface.storage: Harness/a2a/component-nodes/**/state.json is backend-owned diagnostic storage, never an Agent control surface.
controlSurface.outputRouting: Prefer connected writable Markdown nodes for durable notes, reports, task plans, and long-form text.

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never edit component-node state files or the workflow map file.
Never inline a Markdown body in a request payload; share the node by nodeId only.
Never overwrite another writer's changes: always use the lock and expectedRevision, and reread-and-retry on markdown_conflict.
